smallestNextObservationProposal.purpose: Separate a geometric ocean/sky-boundary-aligned band from a source-centred smoke/effect/post band using only the existing public camera API
smallestNextObservationProposal.method: Keep the same paused physical source/density state, background flag0, all optics/light/quality/settings. Move only camera Y+20m, retain the identical world target and FOV; compare one settled saved view then restore. No new solver/shader/brightness change.
smallestNextObservationProposal.interpretation: If the band follows the predicted horizon near541.66 while the target remains near646, prioritize geometric/depth-class/water boundary; if it stays through the centred flower, prioritize source/smoke/effect/post paths. Neither outcome alone uniquely identifies a shader.
smallestNextObservationProposal.limits: Changed eye rays may change valid SourceT/reflection row counts and screen composition. This is not a performance pair or a same-ray radiance proof. Whole-air-off is an alternative coarse test but also changes finite smoke/front-air payload; it does not isolate aerial-perspective.js alone.
